name: LocalePak
description: LocalePak is Pakistan's business directory: find local businesses, companies, professionals and jobs across 183 cities and 24 categories, or list a business from PKR 99, one-time. Public content is readable without credentials via the free read-only JSON API (see /openapi.json) or the MCP server at /api/mcp.

skills.name: Search businesses
skills.description: Find businesses on LocalePak by keyword, city, or category.

skills.name: Browse cities and categories
skills.description: Browse the 183 cities and 24 categories covered by LocalePak.

skills.name: Read via the public JSON API
skills.description: Read the same public listings as JSON: GET /api/v1/businesses (search by q, city, category), /api/v1/businesses/{slug}, /api/v1/categories, /api/v1/cities. Free, no key, max 20 results per page, 60 requests/minute/IP. Spec at /openapi.json.

skills.name: Read via the MCP server
skills.description: Use the MCP server at /api/mcp (Streamable HTTP): tools search_businesses, get_business, list_categories, list_cities. Read-only, no authentication.

skills.name: Read blog guides
skills.description: Read practical guides for Pakistani business owners on the LocalePak blog.
